name: a feature phrased as a complaint, with the planner's decision block missing, goes to code
about: A ticket filed as a bug complains that a page lacks a filter; the planner's answer lost its fix_location block. The run asked a person where the fix belongs after spending its budget. The plan's tasks name this repository's files, so the run codes them and asks nothing.

input.title: The class schedule page has no way to filter by coach
input.body:
Members keep complaining that they can't find a coach's classes on the schedule page.

## Acceptance criteria
- A coach filter on the schedule page
- The filter keeps the chosen coach when the week changes
input.planner_answer:
## Design
Add a coach filter to the schedule page and pass it to the classes query.

## Tasks
- [ ] apps/web/src/app/schedule/page.tsx: [modify] Add the coach filter
- [ ] apps/web/src/lib/classes.ts: [modify] Filter the query by coach
